# Quarantined Phrases

The style-audit ban list: phrases that timestamp prose as machine-written, so
the audit fails any draft containing them. Format rules (one phrase per line,
first-colon permitted contexts, `## Entries` gate; see the `#`-comment and
`|`-row parsing rules in [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)). Everything below
`## Entries` is enforced; everything above is documentation.

## Entries

delve into
delve
tapestry
a testament to
pivotal
crucial
underscor
landscape: use only as a named term of art with citation (e.g. "fitness landscape" in evolutionary computation) or literal geography
foster
navigate the complexit
in the world of
earns its keep
leverage: use with "the existing/available/current tooling/tools/libraries/ecosystem/api", or "leverage points" as the systems-theory term of art
seamlessly
at the end of the day
game-changer
paradigm shift
harness
robust: use as "robust to/against <specified perturbation>" (control theory), as a named technical property (regression robustness), or as one adjective in a concrete enumerative list (e.g. "robust, clear, and maintainable software"); never as a standalone unexplained praise-word
that is not hypothetical
